Load the Excel workbook to begin.
Drop your files here, or click to choose
Drop your year workbooks (.xlsm / .xlsx — one per year, drop as many as you want) and this month’s raw-data file (.xlsx). Each workbook is recognised by the year inside it; the new month is added to the year the raw data belongs to, and the extra years power the year-over-year comparisons.
You can drop the workbooks on their own to view the existing dashboard.
The workbook is read entirely in your browser — nothing is uploaded anywhere. You work one page at a time: use ◀ Prev / Next ▶ (or the ← → arrow keys) to move through the pages. Type in the left Write-Up pane, then click Update Preview — the right (HTML View) shows that same page exactly as it will export. Download Dashboard always produces the full report.
No workbook loaded yet — load the workbook above to start.
Full HTML dashboard preview — exactly what Download Dashboard produces. Click the section tabs inside it.

Reference — Last-Year Averages & Targets

Enter each metric’s last-year average and target. Type values the way they read — 17%, $135, 8:00 (for time), or a plain number. Save to Excel writes them into the Reference sheet of your linked workbook (or downloads an updated copy). These flow into every page’s table.
